notes: §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR16: "If the ADVANCING phrase is not used, automatic advancing will be provided by the implementor to act as if the user had specified AFTER ADVANCING 1 LINE", then items a-h for the phrase. WriteRecord reroutes a WRITE without the phrase to WriteAdvancingRecord (1 line, AFTER) whenever SupportsVerticalPositioning holds, which is now a LINAGE clause or AdvancingDeclared, set from the OPEN for a file whose program writes any ADVANCING phrase (PB5201), closing this row's old gap for a plain WRITE before the first ADVANCING write; BindAdvancing/ScreenAdvancingCount bind and screen the operand, FeatureAdvancing gives a mnemonic-name its feature's rule, and Position, PositionOnLogicalPage, BeginNextLogicalPage, Advance, WriteTravel and Present carry items a, c, d, e, f, g and h. Probes at 85 (work-rs-04/c9, bytes read back): plain, plain, AFTER 1, plain gives a line feed before every record; BEFORE 2, BEFORE 1, AFTER 1, AFTER 3, plain place each record as a-f require; 0 / ZERO / identifier 0 overprint (c); AFTER/BEFORE PAGE without LINAGE write a form feed (h); C01 mnemonic acts as PAGE (d); a negative identifier takes the PAGE arm (b, undefined); on LINAGE 4 TOP 1 BOTTOM 1 AFTER PAGE and BEFORE PAGE reach line 1 of the next logical page, LINAGE-COUNTER 2, 4, 1, 1, 1, 2 (g); an 18-digit identifier is clamped at 2147483647 lines (an implementation limit, f); -1, 1.5, PIC 9V9 COBOL2365 and BEFORE AFTER refused (b, c, rows c3). The witness runs LINAGE-COUNTER through a, c, g and the omitted phrase and reads back a mixed print file. || REFUTED: PARTIAL: an omitted ADVANCING phrase acts as AFTER ADVANCING 1 LINE when the opening program writes an ADVANCING phrase to the file or the file has LINAGE. It does not when the file is EXTERNAL and the ADVANCING writes are in another program of the run unit: the plain WRITEs made before that program is activated are bare records. No open kb/Work note owns this. PB5201 (landed) fixed the internal arm. kb/Work PB5570 holds the defect (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-04.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-04-refute.json; rerun op-20261114/records-rs5a/rerun-log.txt). next.reason: 1985: "If the ADVANCING phrase is used, advancing is provided as follows:"; 2023: "If the physical file does not support vertical positioning, the ADVANCING and END-OF-PAGE phrases are ignored.". 2023 adds cases: the phrases are ignored on files without vertical positioning, and both AFTER and BEFORE may be used together.
